ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-1,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 30-F in the
area bound by:

South Halsted Street; the alley next north of and parallel to West 120" Street; the alley
next east of and parallel to South Halsted Street; West 120" Street

to those of a C3-1, Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

we .
Ronnje Mosley
Alderman, 21% Ward

11957 S. Halsted Street
